baseline: Current combined-weighted-v1 production policy including market overrides
count_interpretation: Parameterized hypotheses grouped by mechanism, not 500 independent algorithms or scientific theories. Numerical duplicate counts are reported separately.
selection: Separate pooled and per-market selections. Minimum 15 eligible development and 8 eligible validation events. Reject development hit regression; require positive validation gains in both Aug17-27 and Aug28-Sep7. Maximize validation hits, ties prefer production then development hits then catalogue order. No test-block routing.
updates: Online candidates predict all markets on a date before adding any labels from that date. Histories for added features start at first replay date. Known-Close may use supplied target Open panel as the live contract permits.
metrics: fixed-budget hits with SP/DP conditional denominators
Sutta6 and present2/absent2 from sp30 probabilities
multiplicity_prior: Unverified structural hypothesis only: SP/DP/TP canonical panel weights 6/3/1
confirmation: Fresh results use frozen selectors. Report paired tests with Holm correction across 117 pooled/market/channel/endpoint selectors. Five days cannot establish stable per-market accuracy. Preserve production absent sufficient evidence.
limitations: All historical dates were previously examined
Frozen upstream coefficients retain historical fitting and policy-selection bias
Known-Close evaluates full Open-panel input, not Sutta-only input
This is not an exhaustive search of all possible predictive mechanisms
